permissions.title: Kron needs one more permission
permissions.text: New modules are here (AutoMod, Anti-raid, Levels, Custom commands). For them to work, Kron needs:
permissions.how: Click **Update permissions**: Discord opens Kron’s authorization page with the right boxes already checked. Confirm, that’s it. Nothing in your setup changes.
